chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Planning Louis Jordan's role so it never overshadowed Ella
summary: Everything Jordan did was agreed beforehand, since he had to fit the band like a puzzle and not compete with Ella.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: you know. If we were going to do something with an arranger, we'd tell what we wanted him to do. If I wanted Van to do something -- "we're going to do this" -- all these things were discussed and laid out. Whatever Louie did in the band we just didn't do it because Louie wanted to do it. It was discussed what Louie was going to do in the band. Because everything that Louie Jordon did had to be something that didn't interfere with what Ella was doing. What Louie would do had to be in Louie's band and a certain part leading up to what Ella was going to come out and do. We can't have him doing something that's going to interfere with Ella, you know. Louie did some great things with us, you know. "Vote For Mr. Rhythm," I used to do that and I let him do that. I had did that before when I first joined the band.
